rules: Ticker, asset, timing, or Index 2 alone never establishes AUTO or PAYNE ownership.
Provider rows are financial truth but not automatically independent trades.
Logical grouping is ticker + side + open_timestamp + close_timestamp and is provisional only.
PAYNE Oct 13+ real fills occur after the current provider export cutoff and are not inserted into provider P/L without a newer provider source.

payneFirstFillCorroboration.ownershipLimit: Activity-All does not expose the preserved PAYNE provider/client order IDs; other rows on the same ticker remain unassigned.

latestActivity.accountingRule: Keep Activity-All separate from realized-P/L accounting until a newer realized-P/L export or exact provider financial join is available.
